item.title: Attorney General Guidelines for Victim and Witness Assistance
item.description: Foreword to the Attorney General Guidelines for Victim and Witness Assistance (2011 ed.) “Our core mission is to pursue justice for criminal acts, and that pursuit includes justice for the victims of and witnesses to crime. Every day, Department personnel encounter individuals harmed by crime or who witnessed others being harmed by crime. How we treat those individuals has a huge impact on their confidence in the criminal justice system and their ability to heal and recover from crime.

item.title: Foreign Corrupt Practices Act of 1977
item.description: Introduction “The Foreign Corrupt Practices Act of 1977 (FCPA) (15 U.S.C. § 78dd-1, et seq.) is a United States federal law that prohibits U.S. citizens and entities from bribing foreign government officials to benefit their business interests.” “The FCPA is applicable worldwide and extends specifically to publicly traded companies and their personnel, including officers, directors, employees, shareholders, and agents. item.title: FBI Victim Assistance Program
item.description: Source: FBI Victims of Crime brochure The FBI’s Commitment to Victims of Crime Each year, the FBI investigates thousands of crimes involving hundreds of thousands of victims, including many child victims. These crimes result in great harm to individuals, families, and communities. Individuals impacted by crime face the daunting task of rebuilding and healing from loss while navigating the criminal justice system. Federal laws protect victims of Federal crime and provide them with a voice during the investigation and prosecution of their case.

item.title: Article 313-1 of the French Criminal Code
item.description: “Fraud is the act, either by the use of a false name or of a false designation, or by the abuse of a true quality, or by the use of fraudulent maneuvers, of deceiving a physical or judicial person and thus to determine, to its prejudice or to the prejudice of a third party, to deliver funds, values or any good, to provide a service or to consent to an act operating obligation or discharge.
